author: Myv
body:
Hello, I am back to present you with a revamped version of Tangled, as we decided it needed this after looking at the feedback and our own personal opinions.

While there are multiple new features on this map as it is a large overhaul of everything we have done, it still has a similar layout and style to our original working, though everything from the block palette to the spawn has changed for more effectiveness and presentation.

Information

Original Creators: Myv and imeme_
Helper: Raikkou (ty <3)
Team Sizes: 20v20 (changed for effectiveness)
Time Limit: 10-15 minutes (not confirmed)
First to: 100 (subject to change also.)
Team Colours: Lime and Blue 

Map Fundamentals

Kit: Iron Sword, Coloured Leather Armour, 2 Golden Apples, 32 Steak, Punch I Bow, 16 Arrows, no blocks.
Download: Will be done if necessary though I am unable to do so as my computer does not recognise the software required.
XML: Will be done if necessary.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/drVkP

NOTE: I have included images of day and night to see which you think is best, though we believe night is best, hence the use of sea lanterns.

Thank you for viewing and feel free to leave feedback below,
Myv, imeme_ and Raikkou
